t: Toupret Fibarex Exterior Powder Filler is a versatile solution for filling, repairing, and localised skimming on various outdoor surfaces. This high-performance white powder filler is fibre-reinforced, providing exceptional adhesion and strength for durable repairs. It is suitable for new or renovated substrates, including concrete, brickwork, and painted surfaces, making it ideal for general building maintenance and renovation projects. The filler can be overcoated with standard water-based masonry paints within 24 hours, ensuring efficient project completion. Its robust formulation ensures a long-lasting finish.
